title: ID0417272-DC/Si-D/SE [MP / SD 170004242]  Outlet is offline
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
Outlet is offline. Two time I have had this heppend. It sets the outlet 1 out of order and the only thing that helps is a reboot. The charger doesnt have any meters.
Root cause:
Coap polling?
Solution: Update EcoG to v1.4.12
Update 7/Apr/2025 - R&D ticket created EVC3-9155
